articles.title: Pineapple Financial puts $1B in mortgage records on Injective
articles.snippet: The mortgage lender plans to bring more than $10 billion in historical loans onchain, turning thousands of mortgage files into blockchain-based records.

articles.title: CFTC files to dismiss CME lawsuit over crypto perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The CFTC’s lawyers called the lawsuit “much ado about nothing,“ claiming that the CME Group lacked standing to file and argued against its claims over crypto perpetual futures.

articles.title: Kalshi seeks CFTC approval for WTI crude perpetual futures: Report
articles.snippet: Kalshi reportedly plans to file for approval of a WTI crude oil perpetual futures contract that would trade around the clock five days a week without an expiration date.

articles.title: Top Pentagon AI Official Sold Millions in Perplexity Stock, Disclosures Show
articles.snippet: Emil Michael's latest financial filings show a summer exit from Perplexity, months after a January sale of xAI stock that reportedly netted him up to $24 million.
